My visit to this clinic in Koh Samui was unfortunately not a positive experience.

At the beginning, I asked for an approximate cost of treatment because I wanted to know what kind of expenses to expect. I was told that a medical examination was required first. I was a bit skeptical, but the doctor assured me that the cost estimate would be free, so I agreed.

After the examination, I was presented with a treatment quote that was about twice as high as the typical prices in the area. Because of this, I decided not to proceed with the treatment. At that point, I was informed that I had to pay 800 baht for the consultation.

This was surprising to me, as I had clearly stated from the beginning that I only wanted an approximate estimate. During the conversation, it was also suggested that the 800 baht fee was related to treatment and would not apply if I decided not to continue.

Additionally, I was offered antibiotics without a clear diagnosis, which raised concerns for me. After visiting another clinic, where I was advised to do a stool test, it turned out that antibiotics were not necessary. If I had taken them blindly, my condition could have actually worsened.

On the positive side, the staff were polite and helpful, and I don’t have any complaints about their attitude—they likely don’t have control over pricing policies.

In the end, I paid less than half the amount at another clinic for proper diagnosis and treatment.

Unfortunately, due to the lack of transparency regarding costs and questionable medical recommendations, I cannot recommend this clinic.
